record_title: Exact essential norms for multipliers on little weighted Lipschitz spaces of rooted trees
provenance: The proof identifies weighted edge-difference coordinates with c0-type sequence spaces, computes the exact coordinate-row functionals of the conjugated multiplier, and applies a finite-coordinate truncation lemma for the essential norm.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem concerns little weighted tree Lipschitz spaces, not the corresponding big spaces modeled on l-infinity. The 2016 Rachel Locke dissertation and the cited 2023 Colonna--Locke graph preprint remain the principal incompletely inspected literature risks.
